name: Gokarna Beach
description: Gokarna is a temple town and beach destination with a string of crescent beaches - Kudle, Om, Half Moon and Paradise - connected by a scenic cliff-top trek.
history: Gokarna is an ancient pilgrimage centre whose Mahabaleshwar Temple is said to house the Atma Linga that Ravana carried from Kailash and was tricked into placing on the ground here.
attractions: Half Moon and Paradise Beach trek
how_to_reach: Gokarna Road station (10 km) is on the Konkan Railway. Overnight buses run from Bengaluru (485 km); Goa airport is 140 km away.
tips: Do the beach trek early morning and carry water. Strong currents make swimming unsafe in the monsoon.
summary_kn: ಓಂ, ಕುಡ್ಲೆ, ಹಾಫ್ ಮೂನ್ ಕಡಲತೀರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮಹಾಬಲೇಶ್ವರ ದೇವಾಲಯಕ್ಕೆ ಗೋಕರ್ಣ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
summary_hi: गोकर्ण ओम, कुडले, हाफ़ मून बीच और महाबलेश्वर मंदिर के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Malpe Beach
description: Malpe is a lively beach near Udupi with water sports, a floating bridge, a sea walk and one of the biggest fishing harbours on the west coast. Boats leave from here to St. Mary's Island.
history: Malpe has been a natural port for centuries and is the traditional landing point for fishing communities of the Udupi coast.
how_to_reach: Malpe is 6 km from Udupi town; city buses and autos are available.
tips: Water sports and island boats pause from June to mid-September due to rough seas.
summary_kn: ಉಡುಪಿ ಸಮೀಪದ ಮಲ್ಪೆ ಕಡಲತೀರ ಜಲಕ್ರೀಡೆ, ಸಮುದ್ರ ನಡಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸೇಂಟ್ ಮೇರಿಸ್ ದ್ವೀಪದ ದೋಣಿಗೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿ.
summary_hi: उडुपी के पास मालपे बीच जल क्रीड़ा, समुद्री पैदल पथ और सेंट मैरी द्वीप की नाव के लिए जाना जाता है।

name: Karwar
description: Karwar is a calm coastal town where the Kali river meets the Arabian Sea, with clean beaches, the INS Chapal warship museum and islands just offshore.
history: Rabindranath Tagore stayed in Karwar in 1882 and wrote about its beauty; the main beach is named after him. Karwar is now home to INS Kadamba, a major naval base.
how_to_reach: Karwar is on the Konkan Railway, 520 km from Bengaluru and 95 km from Goa airport.
tips: Take a sunset ferry ride at the Kali river bridge.
summary_kn: ಕಾಳಿ ನದಿ ಸಮುದ್ರ ಸೇರುವ ಕಾರವಾರ ಶಾಂತ ಕಡಲತೀರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಯುದ್ಧನೌಕೆ ವಸ್ತುಸಂಗ್ರಹಾಲಯಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿ.
summary_hi: जहाँ काली नदी अरब सागर से मिलती है, वह कारवार शांत समुद्र तटों और युद्धपोत संग्रहालय के लिए जाना जाता है।

name: Panambur Beach
description: Panambur Beach in Mangaluru is a clean, well-maintained city beach with lifeguards, jet-ski and boat rides, camel rides and the popular international kite festival.
history: The beach lies next to the New Mangalore Port, developed in the 1970s, which transformed Mangaluru into a major trading hub.
how_to_reach: Panambur is 10 km north of Mangaluru city; Mangaluru has an airport and two railway stations.
tips: Stay within the flagged swimming zone where lifeguards are on duty.
summary_kn: ಮಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಪಣಂಬೂರು ಕಡಲತೀರ ಸ್ವಚ್ಛ, ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ ಮತ್ತು ಗಾಳಿಪಟ ಉತ್ಸವಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
summary_hi: मंगलुरु का पणंबूर बीच साफ़, सुरक्षित और पतंग उत्सव के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Kaup Beach
description: Kaup Beach is a quiet beach near Udupi crowned by a 100-year-old lighthouse on rocky outcrops, offering panoramic views of the coastline at sunset.
history: The Kaup lighthouse was built in 1901 by the British and still guides ships along the Udupi coast. The town also has the ancient Mariamma temples.
how_to_reach: Kaup is 13 km south of Udupi on NH 66; buses between Udupi and Mangaluru stop here.
tips: Climb the lighthouse in the evening for the best view.
summary_kn: ನೂರು ವರ್ಷ ಹಳೆಯ ದೀಪಸ್ತಂಭವಿರುವ ಕಾಪು ಕಡಲತೀರ ಸೂರ್ಯಾಸ್ತ ವೀಕ್ಷಣೆಗೆ ಸುಂದರ ಸ್ಥಳ.
summary_hi: सौ साल पुराने लाइटहाउस वाला कापू बीच सूर्यास्त देखने के लिए सुंदर जगह है।

name: St. Mary's Island
description: St. Mary's Island is a group of four small islands off Malpe famous for rare columnar basalt rock formations, formed by volcanic activity about 88 million years ago.
history: Vasco da Gama is said to have landed here in 1498 and fixed a cross, naming the island after the Virgin Mary. It is a National Geological Monument.
food: No food on island - eat at Malpe
how_to_reach: Boats depart from Malpe Beach (about 30 minutes each way). The island is closed from June to September.
tips: Fee shown is the approximate return boat ticket. Carry water and avoid climbing on slippery rocks.
summary_kn: ಮಲ್ಪೆ ಬಳಿಯ ಸೇಂಟ್ ಮೇರಿಸ್ ದ್ವೀಪ ಅಪರೂಪದ ಷಡ್ಭುಜಾಕಾರದ ಬಸಾಲ್ಟ್ ಶಿಲಾ ರಚನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
summary_hi: मालपे के पास सेंट मैरी द्वीप दुर्लभ षट्कोणीय बेसाल्ट चट्टानों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Maravanthe Beach
description: Maravanthe is a unique stretch where National Highway 66 runs between the Arabian Sea on one side and the Souparnika river on the other, creating one of India's most scenic drives.
history: The Varaha Swamy Temple at Maravanthe is an old shrine of the fishing community; the beach became famous after the highway was built along the narrow sand bar.
how_to_reach: Maravanthe is 55 km north of Udupi and 12 km from Kundapura on NH 66.
tips: Stop here on the Udupi - Gokarna coastal drive; the sea is rough, so avoid swimming.
summary_kn: ಒಂದು ಕಡೆ ಸಮುದ್ರ, ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಕಡೆ ಸೌಪರ್ಣಿಕಾ ನದಿ ನಡುವೆ ಹೆದ್ದಾರಿ ಹಾದುಹೋಗುವ ಮರವಂತೆ ಅಪರೂಪದ ಕಡಲತೀರ.
summary_hi: एक ओर समुद्र और दूसरी ओर सौपर्णिका नदी के बीच से गुज़रता हाईवे मरवंथे को अनोखा बनाता है।

name: Bandipur National Park
description: Bandipur is one of India's finest tiger reserves, part of the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve, with large populations of tigers, elephants, gaur, deer and over 200 bird species.
history: Bandipur was the private hunting reserve of the Maharajas of Mysore and was declared a tiger reserve under Project Tiger in 1973.
timings: Safari 6:30 AM - 9:30 AM and 3:30 PM - 6:00 PM
how_to_reach: Bandipur is 80 km from Mysuru and 220 km from Bengaluru on the Mysuru - Ooty road. The highway inside the park is closed to traffic from 9 PM to 6 AM.
tips: Fee shown is the approximate safari ticket. Book forest department safaris online and wear earthy colours.
summary_kn: ನೀಲಗಿರಿ ಜೀವಗೋಳದ ಭಾಗವಾದ ಬಂಡೀಪುರ ಹುಲಿ, ಆನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಫಾರಿಗೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿಯಾದ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಉದ್ಯಾನ.
summary_hi: नीलगिरि बायोस्फ़ीयर का हिस्सा बांदीपुर बाघ, हाथी और सफ़ारी के लिए प्रसिद्ध राष्ट्रीय उद्यान है।

name: Nagarhole National Park
description: Nagarhole (Rajiv Gandhi National Park) is a dense forest reserve between Kodagu and Mysuru, known for high densities of tigers, leopards and Asian elephants.
history: The park takes its name from the snake-like (naga) winding river (hole) flowing through it. It became a tiger reserve in 1999 and forms a continuous habitat with Bandipur.
timings: Safari 6:00 AM - 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM - 6:00 PM
how_to_reach: Nagarhole is 95 km from Mysuru and 240 km from Bengaluru, accessed via Hunsur or Gonikoppal.
tips: Fee shown is the approximate safari ticket. The park may close for safety during the peak monsoon.
summary_kn: ಕೊಡಗು ಮತ್ತು ಮೈಸೂರು ನಡುವಿನ ನಾಗರಹೊಳೆ ಹುಲಿ, ಚಿರತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆನೆಗಳ ದಟ್ಟ ಕಾಡು.
summary_hi: कोडागु और मैसूरु के बीच नागरहोले बाघों, तेंदुओं और हाथियों का घना जंगल है।

name: Kabini
description: Kabini is a wildlife destination on the Kabini river backwaters at the edge of Nagarhole, famous for elephant herds in summer, boat safaris and sightings of the elusive black panther.
history: The Kabini dam built in 1974 created a reservoir whose receding waters in summer attract one of the largest congregations of Asian elephants.
timings: Safari 6:30 AM - 9:30 AM and 3:30 PM - 6:30 PM
how_to_reach: Kabini is 80 km from Mysuru and 210 km from Bengaluru via HD Kote.
tips: Stays are mostly resort packages that include safaris; book weeks in advance for weekends.
summary_kn: ನಾಗರಹೊಳೆಯ ಅಂಚಿನ ಕಬಿನಿ ಹಿನ್ನೀರು ಆನೆ ಹಿಂಡುಗಳು, ದೋಣಿ ಸಫಾರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕಪ್ಪು ಚಿರತೆಗೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
summary_hi: नागरहोले के किनारे काबिनी बैकवाटर हाथियों के झुंड, नाव सफ़ारी और काले तेंदुए के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Bannerghatta National Park
description: Bannerghatta National Park, just south of Bengaluru, combines a zoo, a grand safari with lions, tigers and bears, an elephant rescue centre and India's first butterfly park.
history: The park was declared a national park in 1974; the butterfly enclosure was opened in 2006 and the biological park is now a major rescue and conservation centre.
how_to_reach: Bannerghatta is 22 km from Bengaluru city centre; BMTC buses run from Majestic and Shivajinagar.
tips: Safari tickets are sold separately and sell out by noon on weekends. The park is closed on Tuesdays.
summary_kn: ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಸಮೀಪದ ಬನ್ನೇರುಘಟ್ಟ ಮೃಗಾಲಯ, ಸಫಾರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಚಿಟ್ಟೆ ಉದ್ಯಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿ.
summary_hi: बेंगलुरु के पास बन्नेरघट्टा चिड़ियाघर, सफ़ारी और तितली पार्क के लिए जाना जाता है।

name: Ranganathittu Bird Sanctuary
description: Ranganathittu is Karnataka's largest bird sanctuary, a cluster of islets on the Kaveri where painted storks, spoonbills, pelicans and river terns nest, best explored by boat.
history: The ornithologist Salim Ali convinced the Maharaja of Mysore to declare these islets a protected area in 1940. It is now a Ramsar wetland site.
how_to_reach: Ranganathittu is 3 km from Srirangapatna and 19 km from Mysuru.
tips: Morning boat rides give the best bird activity; boating costs extra.
summary_kn: ಕಾವೇರಿ ನದಿಯ ದ್ವೀಪಗಳ ಮೇಲಿರುವ ರಂಗನತಿಟ್ಟು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಅತಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಪಕ್ಷಿಧಾಮ; ದೋಣಿ ವಿಹಾರ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಆಕರ್ಷಣೆ.
summary_hi: कावेरी नदी के द्वीपों पर स्थित रंगनथिट्टू कर्नाटक का सबसे बड़ा पक्षी अभयारण्य है; नाव की सवारी मुख्य आकर्षण है।

name: Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary
description: Bhadra Tiger Reserve near Chikkamagaluru is a model of conservation, with jeep safaris through teak and bamboo forests and boat rides on the Bhadra reservoir backwaters.
history: Bhadra became a Project Tiger reserve in 1998 after the voluntary relocation of 26 villages, often cited as one of India's most successful rehabilitation programmes.
timings: Safari 6:30 AM - 9:00 AM and 3:30 PM - 6:00 PM
how_to_reach: Bhadra is 38 km from Chikkamagaluru town; Lakkavalli and Muthodi are the main entry points.
tips: Fee shown is the approximate safari ticket; safaris may be suspended in the monsoon.
summary_kn: ಚಿಕ್ಕಮಗಳೂರು ಸಮೀಪದ ಭದ್ರಾ ಹುಲಿ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಿತ ಪ್ರದೇಶ ಜೀಪ್ ಸಫಾರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹಿನ್ನೀರಿನ ದೋಣಿ ವಿಹಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿ.
summary_hi: चिकमगलूर के पास भद्रा बाघ अभयारण्य जीप सफ़ारी और बैकवाटर नाव यात्रा के लिए जाना जाता है।

name: Dubare Elephant Camp
description: Dubare Elephant Camp on the banks of the Kaveri lets visitors watch trained elephants being bathed and fed, and learn about them from naturalists. River rafting is offered nearby in season.
history: The camp houses elephants once used for Mysuru Dasara and forest work; it is run by the forest department and Jungle Lodges and Resorts.
how_to_reach: Dubare is 15 km from Kushalnagar and 30 km from Madikeri. Cross the river by boat to reach the camp.
tips: Reach before 9 AM to see the elephants being bathed. Activities are priced separately.
summary_kn: ಕಾವೇರಿ ತೀರದ ದುಬಾರೆ ಆನೆ ಶಿಬಿರದಲ್ಲಿ ಆನೆಗಳ ಸ್ನಾನ, ಆಹಾರ ನೀಡುವಿಕೆ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಬಹುದು ಮತ್ತು ರಾಫ್ಟಿಂಗ್ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು.
summary_hi: कावेरी तट पर दुबारे हाथी शिविर में हाथियों को नहलाते और खिलाते देख सकते हैं और राफ्टिंग कर सकते हैं।

name: Dandeli
description: Dandeli is Karnataka's adventure capital, known for white-water rafting on the Kali river, kayaking, zip-lining and jungle stays in the Kali Tiger Reserve, a haven for hornbills.
history: Dandeli grew around timber and paper industries; today the Kali Tiger Reserve (formerly Dandeli-Anshi) protects its forests and black panthers.
how_to_reach: Dandeli is 75 km from Hubballi and 480 km from Bengaluru; Alnavar (32 km) is the nearest railway station.
tips: Fee shown is the approximate cost of a rafting session. Rafting is closed in peak monsoon.
summary_kn: ಕಾಳಿ ನದಿಯ ರಾಫ್ಟಿಂಗ್, ಕಯಾಕಿಂಗ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಳಿ ಹುಲಿ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಿತ ಪ್ರದೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ದಾಂಡೇಲಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಸಾಹಸ ರಾಜಧಾನಿ.
summary_hi: काली नदी की राफ्टिंग, कयाकिंग और काली टाइगर रिज़र्व के लिए दांडेली कर्नाटक की साहसिक राजधानी है।

name: Yana Rocks
description: Yana is famous for two massive black karst rock outcrops, Bhairaveshwara Shikhara (120 m) and Mohini Shikhara, rising out of the Sahyadri forest, with a cave temple at the base.
history: Legend links Yana to the demon Bhasmasura, who was tricked by Vishnu as Mohini into burning himself; the black rocks are said to be blackened by that fire.
how_to_reach: Yana is 40 km from Sirsi and 31 km from Kumta; the last stretch is a short forest walk.
tips: Footwear must be removed near the temple. Combine with Vibhooti Falls and Gokarna.
summary_kn: ಸಹ್ಯಾದ್ರಿ ಕಾಡಿನಿಂದ ಮೇಲೇರುವ ಭೈರವೇಶ್ವರ ಮತ್ತು ಮೋಹಿನಿ ಶಿಖರಗಳ ಕಪ್ಪು ಶಿಲೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಯಾಣ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
summary_hi: सह्याद्रि जंगल से उठती भैरवेश्वर और मोहिनी शिखर की काली चट्टानों के लिए याना प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Savandurga
description: Savandurga is one of the largest monolith hills in Asia, rising 1,226 m above sea level west of Bengaluru, with a steep rock-face trek to fortification ruins on top.
history: The hill was a stronghold of Kempegowda's descendants and later Hyder Ali; the British captured it in 1791. Two temples, Savandi Veerabhadreshwara and Narasimha, sit at the base.
food: Carry snacks; village eateries at base
how_to_reach: Savandurga is 60 km from Bengaluru via Magadi Road; best reached by own vehicle or cab.
tips: The rock face is very steep - avoid climbing when wet and start before 8 AM.
summary_kn: ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಸಮೀಪದ ಸಾವನದುರ್ಗ ಏಷ್ಯಾದ ಅತಿದೊಡ್ಡ ಏಕಶಿಲಾ ಬೆಟ್ಟಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು; ಸಾಹಸ ಚಾರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ.
summary_hi: बेंगलुरु के पास सावनदुर्ग एशिया की सबसे बड़ी एकाश्म पहाड़ियों में से एक है; साहसिक ट्रेक के लिए आदर्श।

name: Talacauvery
description: Talacauvery, on the Brahmagiri hills of Kodagu, is the source of the river Kaveri. A temple tank marks the spring, and steps lead up to a viewpoint over the Western Ghats.
history: Every year on Tula Sankramana in October, thousands gather to witness the holy spring surge at a predetermined moment. Bhagamandala, 8 km below, is the confluence of three rivers.
how_to_reach: Talacauvery is 48 km from Madikeri via Bhagamandala; buses run from Madikeri.
tips: The viewpoint above the temple is very windy and misty - carry a light jacket.
summary_kn: ಕೊಡಗಿನ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಗಿರಿ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ತಲಕಾವೇರಿ ಕಾವೇರಿ ನದಿಯ ಉಗಮ ಸ್ಥಾನ; ಭಾಗಮಂಡಲದಲ್ಲಿ ತ್ರಿವೇಣಿ ಸಂಗಮವಿದೆ.
summary_hi: कोडागु की ब्रह्मगिरी पहाड़ी पर तलकावेरी कावेरी नदी का उद्गम स्थल है; भागमंडला में त्रिवेणी संगम है।

name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
description: Lalbagh is a 240-acre botanical garden in Bengaluru with rare tropical plants, a Victorian glass house that hosts flower shows on Republic Day and Independence Day, and a 3,000-million-year-old rock outcrop.
history: The garden was started by Hyder Ali in 1760 and completed by Tipu Sultan. The glass house, modelled on London's Crystal Palace, was built in 1889. One of Kempegowda's four watch towers stands on the Lalbagh rock.
how_to_reach: Lalbagh is in south Bengaluru; Lalbagh metro station (Green Line) is at the west gate.
tips: Morning walks before 9 AM are free for walkers on some gates; flower shows get crowded on weekends.
summary_kn: ಹೈದರ್ ಅಲಿ ಆರಂಭಿಸಿದ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಲಾಲ್‌ಬಾಗ್ ಗಾಜಿನ ಮನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಫಲಪುಷ್ಪ ಪ್ರದರ್ಶನಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
summary_hi: हैदर अली द्वारा शुरू किया गया बेंगलुरु का लालबाग ग्लास हाउस और पुष्प प्रदर्शनी के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Brindavan Gardens
description: Brindavan Gardens are terraced gardens laid out below the Krishna Raja Sagara (KRS) dam, famous for the evening musical fountain show and illuminated walkways.
history: The KRS dam was designed by Sir M. Visvesvaraya and completed in 1932; the gardens were laid out by Sir Mirza Ismail, Dewan of Mysore, modelled on the Mughal Shalimar gardens.
how_to_reach: Brindavan Gardens are 21 km from Mysuru; KSRTC buses run from the Mysuru city bus stand.
tips: Arrive by 6 PM for the musical fountain; the gardens get very crowded on weekends.
summary_kn: ಕೆಆರ್‌ಎಸ್ ಅಣೆಕಟ್ಟೆಯ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಬೃಂದಾವನ ಉದ್ಯಾನ ಸಂಜೆಯ ಸಂಗೀತ ಕಾರಂಜಿ ಪ್ರದರ್ಶನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿ.
